Private team submissions · All three phases

Canvas Submission Workflow

Use one clearly named team submission at each approval gate so the committee's decision trail, owned work, and licensed evidence remain private and reviewable.

Canvas is the private submission record

The Canvas assignment controls the due date, points, availability window, and attempt policy. This guide controls the required package, filenames, and public/private boundary.

Rules that apply at every gate

Submit once, verify twice

  • One designated submitter uploads the complete package for the Canvas group; all four members confirm the receipt before the deadline.
  • Use Team01, Team02, and so on in filenames. Replace the two-digit placeholder; do not add student names to filenames.
  • Keep formulas live in required XLSX files. Export narrative and exhibit deliverables to PDF unless PPTX or XLSX is explicitly required.
  • Put only licensed FactSet evidence in the private evidence ZIP. Do not place credentials, raw student data, or unrelated downloads in the bundle.
  • Before submitting, open every file, confirm the three assigned clients and four analyst owners are visible, and verify that all cited as-of dates match the analysis.
  • After upload, open the Canvas submission receipt and confirm that every required filename appears. A local file or public-repository link is not a submission.

Phase 1 Canvas gate

BUS331 Investment Committee · Phase 1 Gate · Frame the Mandate

Decision recorded

Approve or revise the common market view and all three client mandates before portfolio construction begins.

Upload these exact files

Required fileBUS331_Team##_Phase1_MandateMemo.pdfOne-page committee mandate memo covering the common market view and three client mandates.
Required fileBUS331_Team##_Phase1_Macro.xlsxCompleted macro starter workbook with human-first read, consensus comparison, and bull/base/bear scenarios.
Required fileBUS331_Team##_Phase1_ClientIPS.pdfOne combined PDF containing the three completed client IPS documents in assigned-client order.
Required fileBUS331_Team##_Phase1_DecisionRecord.xlsxCurrent Analyst Decision Log and signed Phase 1 vote with four-role-by-three-client coverage.

Pre-submission check

  • Scenario probabilities total 100% and every macro claim has a source and as-of date.
  • Each client has an objective, RRTTLLU constraints, return target, volatility limit, drawdown tripwire, and unresolved information gaps.
  • The Decision Record shows initial judgment, AI challenge, human verification, final reasoning, downstream guardrail, owner, and peer reviewer.
  • All four members recorded the Phase 1 vote and any revision action.

Allowed file extensions: .pdf, .xlsx

Phase 2 Canvas gate

BUS331 Investment Committee · Phase 2 Gate · Build and Challenge

Decision recorded

Approve, revise, or reject each client portfolio after the locked baseline, instructor-issued Scenario Reveal, full IPS review, corrective trade, and re-test.

Upload these exact files

Required fileBUS331_Team##_Phase2_CME.xlsxCompleted capital-market-expectations and optimization workbook.
Required fileBUS331_Team##_Phase2_SecuritySelection.xlsxCompleted bond, mutual-fund, and ETF comparisons, Issuer Reality Checks, AI decisions, and FactSet Evidence Log.
Required fileBUS331_Team##_Phase2_BaselineSnapshot.pdfSubmitted baseline allocation, IPS scorecard, and initial stress result retained before the Scenario Reveal.
Required fileBUS331_Team##_Phase2_StressTest.xlsxScenario Release Log, integrated allocation, full IPS scorecard, revealed-scenario results, corrective trades, and re-test.
Required fileBUS331_Team##_Phase2_DecisionRecord.xlsxCurrent committee record with client-by-client votes, dissent, actions, owners, and deadlines.
Required fileBUS331_Team##_Phase2_LicensedEvidence.zipPrivate course-use evidence files referenced by the FactSet Evidence Log; no credentials or unrelated exports.

Pre-submission check

  • Every recommended bond, mutual fund, and ETF passed a documented candidate comparison and client guardrail check.
  • Issuer Reality Checks and licensed-evidence references cover every required direct and look-through exposure.
  • The baseline snapshot was submitted before the Scenario Reveal; every client allocation totals 100%, all IPS objectives and constraints were re-tested, and every revealed breach has a corrective trade and full re-test.
  • All four members recorded the Phase 2 vote and can identify the evidence they own and reviewed.

Allowed file extensions: .xlsx, .zip

Phase 3 Canvas gate

BUS331 Investment Committee · Phase 3 Gate · Defend the Recommendation

Decision recorded

Issue one integrated recommendation for all three clients, preserve the audit trail, and arrive ready for the scheduled committee defense.

Upload these exact files

Required fileBUS331_Team##_Phase3_DecisionMemo.pdfFinal committee decision memo with recommendation first, client-specific actions, reservations, and monitoring triggers.
Required fileBUS331_Team##_Phase3_TechnicalDossier.pdfAuditable exhibit book linking macro, mandates, allocations, security evidence, stress results, corrections, and sources.
Required fileBUS331_Team##_Phase3_Presentation.pptxFinal visual committee presentation with balanced speaking responsibility.
Required fileBUS331_Team##_Phase3_DecisionRecord.xlsxFinal vote, dissent or reservations, implementation actions, Analyst Decision Log, and AI audit appendix.
Required fileBUS331_Team##_Phase3_LicensedEvidence.zipFinal private evidence bundle containing only licensed supporting files cited in the dossier and Evidence Log.

Pre-submission check

  • The memo, dossier, presentation, and decision record state the same allocations, securities, and monitoring actions.
  • Every recommendation traces backward to a Phase 1 client guardrail and forward to a monitoring trigger.
  • Every material number has a source, definition, unit, as-of date, interpretation, and limitation.
  • Each member can defend owned work and answer questions outside that workstream during the scheduled oral defense.

Allowed file extensions: .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx, .zip

Submission receipt

The gate is not complete until the team confirms Canvas

After the designated submitter uploads the package, each member opens the Canvas receipt, confirms the required filenames, and records the receipt check in the committee Decision Record. If a file is missing or cannot be opened, use the attempt and revision policy shown in Canvas.
